{{Quote|Minimal casualties, maximum effectiveness. That's us.|Broadside, on Shadow Squadron|audio=MaxEffectivenesstrim-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
'''Broadside''' was the name of an experienced [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], destroyed several Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], Broadside and the rest of his squadron accompanied Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus testing facility]] to acquire [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] for an attack on the ''Malevolence''. After taking the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] shortcut through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] and braving the danger there posed by [[Neebray/Legends|neebray mantas]], Broadside and Shadow Squadron [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|engaged]] the ''Malevolence'' and destroyed its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], preventing Grievous from attacking the Republic's [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. Skywalker then took the remainder of his squadron to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to recuperate for the pursuit of the ''Malevolence''. Broadside additionally helped to defend [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] when it was [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|attacked]] by Confederate [[Troop/Legends|troops]] under the command of Grievous and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], flying alongside Skywalker in a Y-wing to repel the invading Confederate fleet. The Republic eventually forced the Separatists to retreat, securing the clone [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Biography==
===Acquiring Y-wing bombers===
{{Quote|Form up, Broadside, you're drifting.''"<br />"''Sorry, General. These birds need a bit more work.|Skywalker and Broadside, on their new Y-wing bombers|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Procedure" />}}
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who took on the name "Broadside" served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was friends with fellow [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick]], with whom he often bet on outgoing missions as a sort of ritual and good luck charm.<ref name="CCE" /><ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Broadside and the rest of his squadron prepared to accompany [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a mission to hunt down the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had been attacking Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Broadside had become an experienced pilot.<ref name="CCE" />

[[File:Broadside_leaving_Bormus.png|thumb|left|200px|Broadside, as he departs Bormus]]
To acquire [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] for the impending assault on the ''Malevolence'', Broadside and the rest of Shadow Squadron accompanied Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]&mdash;Skywalker's personal [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]]&mdash;to the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus testing facility]], which was tasked with manufacturing and testing the new Y-wing [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. While conferring with a [[Unidentified Gran worker|Gran worker]] at the facility, Skywalker ordered Broadside and Matchstick to enter the [[Hangar 8122|hangar]] where the bombers were being stored. While Skywalker and Tano acquired authorization from the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] to take the bombers by threatening to report him to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Matchstick informed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] guarding the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that having a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with them qualified as clearance to enter the hangar. Broadside and the rest of Shadow Squadron then departed the facility in the Y-wings, while Skywalker and Tano left in the ''Twilight''. As they headed away from [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]], Skywalker noted that Broadside was drifting out of formation. Broadside apologized and explained that his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] needed more work.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Procedure" />

After bringing the bombers to Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Broadside and Shadow Squadron were briefed by Skywalker and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. Skywalker explained that their attack on the ''Malevolence'' would target its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] in order to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] its [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. After the briefing, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who had been rescued following an [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|encounter]] with the ''Malevolence'', asked Skywalker if Shadow Squadron was capable of carrying out its assigned task, and both Matchstick and Broadside assured him that they were prepared.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

===Attack on the ''Malevolence''===
{{Quote|Broadside, we make it through this one, drinks are on me.''"<br />"''I can already taste it.|Matchstick and Broadside|audio=DrinksAreOnMe-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
Shortly afterward, Grievous's [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|attack]] on a Republic medical convoy near [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]] revealed that the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} next target was the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], a Republic [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] that was treating over 60,000 wounded [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Skywalker devised a plan to intercept Grievous and departed from the ''Resolute'' along with Shadow Squadron and Koon, who flew in [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|his Delta-7B interceptor]]. Before leaving, Matchstick made a bet with Broadside, stating that if they survived the battle, drinks were on Matchstick. Once they departed, the Republic forces took the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] shortcut through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in an attempt to beat the ''Malevolence'' to the medcenter. In transit through the nebula, Broadside and his squadron encountered several large [[Neebray/Legends|neebray mantas]], which were passing through the nebula on their nesting run and posed a danger to the fighters due to their sheer size. Skywalker responded by ordering his squadron to assume the single-file [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]] and follow him out of the nebula. Shadow Squadron arrived near the medcenter shortly before the ''Malevolence'' came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

[[File:Broadside_helmet.png|thumb|right|225px|Broadside, in his Y-wing fighter]]
Upon arriving at the medical station, Grievous ordered his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] crew to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|fire]] the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] at the departing [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|frigates]] that were evacuating clones from Kaliida Shoals. Meanwhile, Broadside and Shadow Squadron [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] deployed by Grievous's flagship. The ''Malevolence'' fired one of its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] at the Republic squadron, and Broadside and his [[unit]] were immediately ordered to head for the top edge of the ion ray to avoid being neutralized. However, the blast deactivated three of the Y-wing bombers, as well as most of the Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]]. The [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of Matchstick's starfighter also failed, causing it to collide with fellow [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] fighter and killing both Matchstick and Tag.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Despite its losses, Broadside and Shadow Squadron continued its assault on the ''Malevolence'', but at Tano's urging, Skywalker finally changed the target from the warship's bridge to its starboard ion cannon, which was targeting the medcenter. Using [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], Broadside and his squadron managed to disable the cannon. Due to the amount of damage, both cannons overloaded and exploded when fired, damaging the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] in the process. While [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived with three Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and began to attack the ''Malevolence'', Broadside, Tano, Skywalker and their squadron landed inside the medical center to regroup and recuperate before pursuing the ''Malevolence''. Thanks in part to Broadside's and Shadow Squadron's efforts, the ''Malevolence'' was prevented from fleeing to hyperspace because of its damaged hyperdrive<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and was eventually destroyed, although Grievous survived the warship's obliteration.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

===Defending Kamino===
{{Quote|Good to see you, General. Ready to have some fun?''"<br />"''You know me, Broadside. I'd rather be up here than stuck in a command center.|Broadside and Skywalker|<ref name="ARCT">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Broadside-ARCT.png|thumb|left|225px|Broadside participates in the defense of Kamino.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the Republic intercepted a transmission between Grievous and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. After Jedi Generals Skywalker and Kenobi examined the message and discovered that the Confederacy were planning to invade [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Broadside went with the two Jedi to Kamino to prepare the planet for the impending assault. [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Engaging]] the Confederate fleet [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Kamino, Broadside, once again serving under Skywalker and flying a Y-wing, was part of the starfighter force that fought the Confederate fleet, which was under the command of Grievous. However, Skywalker had to depart back to Kamino to help Kenobi, and left Broadside and other clone pilots on their own in space. Eventually, Grievous and Ventress escaped the Kamino system, which ended the invasion.<ref name="ARCT" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:ShadowSquadron.png|thumb|right|200px|Broadside and Matchstick]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]],<ref name="CCE" /> Broadside had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Procedure" /> Like all clones of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="CCE" /> Broadside was confident and believed that Shadow Squadron was capable of completing its missions with "minimal casualties and maximum effectiveness."<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> Trained in military tactics, he was also an experienced pilot and was eager to be one of the first to fly a new Y-wing fighter.<ref name="CCE" /> While serving under Skywalker, Broadside obeyed the orders the Jedi General gave to him. Broadside was also friends with fellow pilot Matchstick, even making a bet with him on the outcome of their assault on the ''Malevolence''<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> as a good luck charm, like most pilots did upon leaving for a mission. Furthermore Broadside had a more superior vision which was required for being a clone pilot. In combat, he used a [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15 blaster pistol]].<ref name="CCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Broadside first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Procedure|''Procedure'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], which led into "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, in which Broadside also appeared. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all of the clone troopers in the television series.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" />
